name: fishball-core
description: Fishball's core plugin: the Fishball manager, its slim app and persona, the private Skills tool, and its fishball-ui component (page, recommended tab and generic slim settings with a settings-section extension point).
//: A DSH bundle of the Fishball plugin set (R-FB-01, design §1.2, §9.1). V3 R-CORE moved the slim child, persona, private Skills tool and child-web pages here unchanged; in a hosted child the instance places this package as a bundle, last (I-PLACE). cordis.patch.yml carries the fishball-ui guard rows, core's fishball preset and the guard row ui/patch (F-GUARDS), and the page, Recommended tab and slim child rows (I-PLACE); ./client is fishball-ui's browser half with the settings panel chunk client.settings.js. It never depends on dsh-instance (TQ-R3, R-BND-01).
//exports: ./slim/* are the slim child modules core's own patch mounts as fishball-core/<subpath> rows (a path row inside this folder would be a second client source of the package; I-PLACE). ./contracts and ./mcp-schema are K3's runtime constants and the vendored K1 schema, for plugins that import them dynamically.
//files: contracts/constants.js is K3's one data-only runtime module (K3 amendment 2026-11-14); src/ imports it, so it ships, while the contract's .d.ts files are types only and do not. vendor/ is the committed copy of dsh-connector/mcp-schema (and the K2 and V2 contract files it imports) that core's link reads (design §9.1; user decision 2026-11-14). It is generator output: refresh it with node scripts/vendor-mcp-schema.mjs after a contract change, never by hand; REL-PACK runs the same script. scripts/ is not shipped.
//dependencies: fishball-shared holds the modules core shares with the instance (R-ARCH-08); it is bundled, so the tarball carries it. @modelcontextprotocol/client is core's own MCP client for its link (F-LINK; design §5a.1, §6.3, §9.1), never the host's transitive copy: pinned exactly to 2.2.0, the line both hosts ship (0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1, dist byte-identical), as K1 pins the connector's server SDK to the same line.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation, as for dsh-instance. dsh-atomic-write (the plugin manager's profile-manifest lock) and dsh-scope (an agent's parent scope) are read by src/guards (F-GUARDS). dsh-connector is a peer for the same reason as the instance's (user decision 2026-11-12): it is not published, so a plain dependency would send an install to a registry; core imports only its ./contract export, until F-STATUS replaces it; the link reads ./mcp-schema from the vendored copy in vendor/, never from this peer (design §9.1). Its range is the instance's. cosmokit, dsh-app-boot and dsh-llm-pi-ai are the peers of the bundled fishball-shared modules core loads (provider-sync). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate.
